correctness.rationale: A colour class is permitted iff it has at most q=r-1 tokens. With no direct target move, a sink strongly connected component of unsettled transfers must be nontrivial, saturated, isolated and balanced: summing incoming<=outgoing degree forces equality. Reverse Euler-tour recolouring through one unused colour settles the component in m+1 legal moves and permanently completes at least 2q vertices. Therefore at most floor(n/(2q)) extra moves. Disjoint full two-colour swaps force this many non-target first moves, giving the exact lower bound. An independent BFS verifier checks 17 small parameter instances; a constructive checker verifies 1028 paths/witnesses.

value.rationale: Exact stable diameter is explicitly requested in the motivating 2026 hypergraph reconfiguration problem. The formula solves a natural family of all complete uniform hypergraphs at every size and rank, exhibiting an exact periodic capacity boundary for compulsory temporary moves and sharpening a general interval bound to equality. The minimum stability threshold is an independently meaningful open limit.
